about_the_game:
Academy Love Saga: Tennis Angels EX Artbook showcases a vibrant collection of character illustrations, unreleased sketches, and evocative scene artwork from the game, alongside exclusive early concepts that didn’t make it into the final release.

Content Highlights:

  • Character Introductions: Detailed profiles, including in-depth backgrounds, personal histories, and physical attributes such as body types and distinctive features of main characters in the game.

  • H-Scenes with Variations: Stunning artwork of key romantic scenes, including alternate versions exclusive to the artbook, and initial sketches showcasing the development of the special clothing-tear effect used in the game.

  • Memorable Dialogues: A heartfelt revisit of the game’s most iconic and emotional lines.

  • Initial Character Designs: Early concept art revealing the creative evolution of the characters.

  • Cover Art Creation Process: A behind-the-scenes look at the design journey of the game’s captivating cover art.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains adult themes, strong language, and fictional characters depicted in non-explicit sexual situations. All characters portrayed are over the age of 18. The game includes partial nudity (with some scenes featuring censored nude characters), sexual themes, and dialogue that references sexual content—including non-consensual acts, exhibitionism, and BDSM. However, no explicit sexual content is shown.
